Katarina

the Sinister Blade

Katarina is a hyper-mobile assassin who blinks around the fight, picks up her daggers and resets her cooldowns with every takedown. One kill can turn into a pentakill if the enemy team is low and grouped. She's one of the strongest mids this patch, but she rewards precise dagger play and good timing far more than raw aggression.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

When to pick Katarina

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Risky. Ranged mages and tanky champions with crowd control can shut her down, so she's better picked after you see the enemy mid.

Pick into

  • Immobile mages who can't run from her blinks, like Syndra and Taliyah
  • Squishy teams with little crowd control, where her resets chain into multi-kills
  • Compositions that group up in messy fights she can clean up
  • Teams where your side has strong engage to start fights for her

Avoid into

  • Teams with lots of crowd control that cancels Death Lotus, like Galio and Malzahar
  • Sustain mages who outlast her poke, like Vladimir
  • Magic-shield champions who blunt her burst, like Kassadin

Great teammates

AmumuHis ultimate holds the whole enemy team still while Katarina spins in the middle.
MalphiteHis Unstoppable Force knocks up the enemy team, the perfect setup for Death Lotus.
Jarvan IVCataclysm traps enemies inside so they can't walk out of Katarina's ultimate.

Your team needs: Pick Katarina when your team has hard engage to start fights and soak up crowd control before she goes in.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Takedowns massively reduce her cooldowns, so she can chain kills in teamfights
  • Shunpo can blink to any unit, ally or enemy, or to her own daggers, so she's very slippery
  • Huge area damage when she picks up daggers in a group
  • Excellent at roaming and cleaning up fights after her team engages

Weaknesses

  • Death Lotus is a channel; any stun, knock-up or silence cancels it
  • Weak in lane against ranged mages who can poke her before she gets in
  • Very squishy: if she goes in before the enemy uses crowd control, she dies
  • Needs kills and resets; a tanky team with lots of crowd control shuts her down

Power spikes

  • Level 3: Q-W-E lets you trade with dagger pickups and threaten kills on low-health laners
  • Level 6: Death Lotus turns any low-health enemy into a kill; roam to side lanes
  • First item (Lich Bane): much stronger trades and burst
  • Two items (Shadowflame): you one-shot squishies and start chaining resets
  • Dark Seal stacks: your Dark Seal start (and Mejai's Soulstealer later) rewards takedowns

Top tips

  • Watch where your daggers land and plan your Shunpo to that spot
  • Picking up a dagger lowers Shunpo's cooldown, so more pickups mean more blinks
  • Never channel Death Lotus into unused crowd control
  • Wait for the fight to start before going in: Katarina is a clean-up assassin
  • Use Shunpo on allies, minions and wards to escape, not only to engage
  • Roam after pushing your wave: side lanes are where Kat gets her first kills
  • Buy Zhonya's Hourglass early against teams with lots of burst
